title: The Second Note
caption: THE OBSERVER WORLD — Chapter I, Episode 9: The Second Note. Do is home, and the Keeper calls for the second note — but TWO lights answer, almost identical. Which one is Re? The first will not rest on Re's space: it slides between the steps, and against Do it clashes — too close. It is a between-stone: a sharp ♯. The second steps true — Do, Re — a whole step home, a half step between. The sharp bows and slips away, waiting for another song. Two notes found; six more to go. (The hidden lesson: whole steps vs half steps, and what accidentals are.)  the more you know, the more you observe.  #theobserver #animation #ambient #music #solfege #storytelling
